systems.name: DRM Control Plane
systems.description: Coordinates governance policies, system registry, ownership, dependencies and change workflows; does not replace subsystem ownership.

systems.name: DRM Universal Motion Engine
systems.description: Owns motion timing, easing, animation orchestration and reduced-motion behavior.

systems.name: DRM Universal Sizing System
systems.description: Owns dimensions, typography sizing, spacing, icons and layout geometry.

systems.name: DRM Universal Positioning System
systems.description: Owns positioning modes, containing-block intent, logical offsets, anchors and stacking layers.

systems.name: DRM Universal Color System
systems.description: Owns color values, semantic color meaning, themes and color-related accessibility rules.

systems.name: DRM AI Continuity Protocol
systems.description: Maintains repository-based onboarding, verified project state, decisions and recovery guidance for AI handover.

systems.name: DRM Code Archaeology & Cleanup Engine
systems.description: Collects evidence about code usage and produces risk-classified cleanup proposals; initial mode is analysis-only.
